integrity: All algebra is over F_2. The proof explicitly identifies the source x- and (x+1)-valuations with the z=y+1 valuation on the invariant subring F_2[y], proves the exact block transition, and separates the finite replay from the universal argument.
limitations: The proof is specific to the Mersenne-power family and does not settle the other length conjectures or a worst-case stopping-time bound for arbitrary binary polynomials. The finite verifier only corroborates ranks through R=8; universality comes from the symbolic block proof.
title: Exact odd-sequence lengths for the Mersenne-power binary Collatz family
